top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a specific, identifiable invention (magic-wavelength trapping of neutral atoms) and its decisive realisation, with a compact two-name allocation, reproduced 1e-18 performance across independent laboratories and a citation scoped to the neutral-atom lattice so it is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. P002 is excellent science with a reproduced phenomenology, but its experimental credit omits the first author of the 2018 work and twist-angle disorder complicates what is intrinsic, so I rank it second; any award is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented link to Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer (Chalmers colleague Johansson is not tied to these proposals)
